title: The Bespoke Planner
body: Every planner you have ever bought was built for someone else’s brain. Nine questions, and one gets made for yours — emailed as a printable PDF, usually within a couple of hours. £10.

name: planner-the-questions
title: Nine questions, one planner
body: Time-blocked or a list? Morning brain or evening brain? Spoons, battery, or no energy tracking at all? Big text and no italics? Answer, and the planner is built around it. £10, printable.
caption:
The questions the Bespoke Planner asks, so you know what you’re in for: 🐸

Time-blocked days, or a list? Does your brain arrive in the morning or the evening? Track energy as spoons, as a battery, or not at all? Do you want tasks broken into first steps? Which extras — sensory notes, safe foods, appointment prep, a joy log? Easy-read: bigger text, more space, no italics?

That’s most of it. Answer, and a planner is built around your answers and emailed to you. £10, print it as often as you like.
